oracle_execution.location: _compare_summary during first Stage-8 confirmatory endpoint comparison

diagnosis: Stage-8 confirmatory summaries store the per-seed vector under 'effects'; the generic Stage-9 summary schema stores it under 'values'. The oracle used the Stage-9 field name for both and crashed before producing a discrepancy ledger.
correction: v1.1 adds an explicit Stage-8 effects-to-values comparison adapter and fail-safe unexpected-exception report writing.
